text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          load: true
          tags: opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest
          format: 'table'
          exit-code: '1'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM'
```
